nodes.name: alquimia_interface.c
nodes.summary: Creates the generic Alquimia engine interface by selecting the PFLOTRAN, CrunchFlow, or ONNX implementation and wiring its function table at runtime.

nodes.name: crunch_alquimia_interface.h
nodes.summary: Declares the CrunchFlow implementation of the generic Alquimia engine lifecycle, condition processing, reaction stepping, auxiliary output, and metadata hooks.

nodes.name: onnx_alquimia_config.c
nodes.summary: Parses and validates ONNX adapter JSON config, including tensor-to-state mappings, model-path resolution, and named initial conditions, with centralized cleanup on failure.

nodes.name: onnx_alquimia_config.h
nodes.summary: Defines the private ONNX config ownership model for tensor mappings and named initial conditions, plus load and cleanup entry points.

nodes.name: onnx_alquimia_interface.c
nodes.summary: Implements the ONNX Runtime reaction-engine adapter: session and tensor setup, config mapping validation, condition routing, inference, state updates, metadata export, and ordered resource teardown.

nodes.name: onnx_alquimia_interface.h
nodes.summary: Declares the ONNX implementation of the generic Alquimia setup, shutdown, condition, reaction-step, auxiliary-output, and metadata callbacks.

nodes.name: pflotran_alquimia_interface.h
nodes.summary: Declares the PFLOTRAN implementation of the generic Alquimia engine lifecycle, condition processing, reaction stepping, auxiliary output, and metadata hooks.

nodes.name: alquimia_memory.h
nodes.summary: Declares the allocation and cleanup API for Alquimia vectors, chemistry state, metadata, properties, constraints, and aggregate data structures.

nodes.name: DriverOutput.c
nodes.summary: Implements pluggable Gnuplot and Python output writers for simulation vectors, including conversion of interleaved multi-component data into per-variable columns.

nodes.name: DriverOutput.h
nodes.summary: Defines the public opaque output interface, writer factories, and APIs for exporting ordinary and multi-component simulation vectors.

nodes.name: TransportDriver.c
nodes.summary: Implements a one-dimensional reactive transport driver that parses INI input, manages chemistry-engine state, advances mobile components with finite-volume advection and operator-split reactions, and assembles output fields.

nodes.name: TransportDriver.h
nodes.summary: Declares transport coupling modes, the complete user-input structure, and the lifecycle, execution, and output APIs for the reactive transport driver.

nodes.name: batch_chem.c
nodes.summary: Command-line entry point that runs a batch geochemistry simulation, selects Python or Gnuplot output, writes final state data, and releases driver resources.

nodes.name: transport.c
nodes.summary: Command-line entry point that configures and runs the reactive transport driver, exports its final solute and auxiliary fields, and performs optional PETSc shutdown.

nodes.name: alquimia_util.h
nodes.summary: Declares C-compatible utilities for strings, named-index lookup, deep copying, vector resizing, and diagnostic printing of Alquimia data structures.

nodes.name: BatchChemDriver.c
nodes.summary: Implements the standalone batch chemistry simulation driver, including INI parsing, engine setup, reaction stepping, state-history capture, cleanup, and output-vector assembly.

nodes.name: BatchChemDriver.h
nodes.summary: Defines batch chemistry input fields and the public lifecycle, execution, and result-retrieval API for the opaque BatchChemDriver.

nodes.name: ini.c
nodes.summary: Implements the embedded inih parser for INI sections, key-value pairs, comments, multiline values, stream callbacks, and file-backed parsing.

nodes.name: ini.h
nodes.summary: Declares the inih callback interfaces, parse entry points, and compile-time options for multiline input, BOM support, storage, and error handling.

nodes.name: input_util.c
nodes.summary: Implements reusable INI-driven construction and parsing for chemistry engines, regions, states, material properties, geochemical conditions, constraints, and output settings.

nodes.name: input_util.h
nodes.summary: Declares high-level input sweeps and low-level section parsers for engine setup, regions, state, properties, and geochemical constraints.

nodes.name: alquimia_constants.c
nodes.summary: Defines shared string limits, geochemical quantity names, engine identifiers, and error codes used throughout the Alquimia C interface.

nodes.name: alquimia_constants.h
nodes.summary: Declares the public constants for supported engines, geochemical quantities, string limits, and Alquimia error codes.

nodes.name: alquimia_containers.h
nodes.summary: Defines the C-compatible vectors and geochemical state, property, metadata, condition, constraint, and engine-status structures shared with reaction engines and Fortran bindings.

nodes.name: alquimia_interface.h
nodes.summary: Defines the engine-neutral AlquimiaData aggregate and the AlquimiaInterface function-pointer contract for setup, reaction stepping, condition processing, metadata, and auxiliary output.

nodes.name: alquimia_memory.c
nodes.summary: Implements allocation and release helpers for every dynamically sized Alquimia vector, state, metadata, condition, constraint, and aggregate data structure.

nodes.name: alquimia_util.c
nodes.summary: Provides shared comparison, lookup, deep-copy, resize, and diagnostic printing operations for Alquimia containers and geochemical data structures.

nodes.name: CMakeLists.txt
nodes.summary: Defines the core Alquimia library build, conditionally adds PFLOTRAN, CrunchFlow, and ONNX engine sources and dependencies, and installs the library and public headers.

nodes.name: alquimia.c
nodes.summary: Implements process-wide error and abort callbacks plus formatted version reporting for the public C API.

nodes.name: alquimia.h.in
nodes.summary: CMake-configured public header template exposing version flags, engine availability macros, assertions, error callbacks, abort callbacks, and version output.

nodes.name: alquimia_containers.F90
nodes.summary: Defines ISO_C_BINDING-compatible Fortran mirrors of the public Alquimia sizes, state, properties, metadata, status, constraint, and auxiliary-data containers.

nodes.name: alquimia_fortran_interface_mod.F90
nodes.summary: Provides an object-oriented Fortran facade over the C Alquimia interface, converting stored C function pointers into callable engine procedures and exposing allocation bindings.

nodes.name: c_f_interface_module.F90
nodes.summary: Implements reusable C/Fortran string conversions and a case-insensitive Fortran string comparison used by chemistry-engine adapters.

nodes.name: crunch_alquimia_interface.F90
nodes.summary: Implements the full CrunchFlow-backed Alquimia engine lifecycle, constraint processing, operator-split reaction stepping, metadata extraction, and state translation.

nodes.name: crunch_alquimia_wrappers.F90
nodes.summary: Exports stable BIND(C) entry points that forward the generic Alquimia engine operations to the CrunchFlow Fortran module despite compiler-specific module symbol mangling.

nodes.name: Makefile
nodes.summary: Builds standalone C++/Fortran interoperability experiments for derived types, strings, and pointer-backed structure arrays, with cleanup targets for generated artifacts.

nodes.name: README
nodes.summary: Briefly identifies the mixed-language directory as a sandbox for C and Fortran interface experiments.

nodes.name: cc-f90-strings.F90
nodes.summary: Fortran side of a mixed-language string experiment that reverses a fixed-length C-compatible character buffer.

nodes.name: cc-f90-strings.cc
nodes.summary: C++ driver for testing fixed-buffer string exchange with Fortran, including buffer clearing and invocation of the Fortran reversal routine.

nodes.name: cc-f90-strings.h
nodes.summary: Declares shared constants and the external Fortran string-reversal symbol used by the mixed C++/Fortran example.

nodes.name: struct-array-pointer.F90
nodes.summary: Fortran half of an interoperability experiment that maps a C structure array and nested pointer fields, creates output arrays, and writes results back through C pointers.

nodes.name: struct-array-pointer.cc
nodes.summary: C++ half of a C/Fortran structure-array experiment that allocates nested buffers, invokes Fortran processing, prints results, and frees owned memory.

nodes.name: struct-derived.F90
nodes.summary: Fortran routine used to verify layout compatibility by mutating numeric fields in a derived type passed from C++.

nodes.name: struct-derived.cc
nodes.summary: C++ driver that constructs a plain numeric structure, passes it to Fortran for mutation, and prints values before and after the call.

nodes.name: pflotran_alquimia_interface.F90
nodes.summary: Implements the PFLOTRAN-backed Alquimia engine, including setup, conditions, operator-split reaction solves, auxiliary output, metadata, and bidirectional state packing.

nodes.name: pflotran_alquimia_wrappers.F90
nodes.summary: Exports stable BIND(C) wrappers for PFLOTRAN-backed setup, shutdown, condition processing, reaction stepping, auxiliary output, and metadata operations.

nodes.name: pflotran_petsc_stubs.F90
nodes.summary: Provides a no-op PETSc logging entry point required when linking the PFLOTRAN adapter in configurations without the full logging implementation.

nodes.name: CMakeLists.txt
nodes.summary: Defines and installs the batch-chemistry and one-dimensional reactive-transport driver executables linked against Alquimia.

nodes.name: LICENSE.inih.txt
nodes.summary: Records the BSD license terms for the bundled inih configuration parser used by the driver programs.

nodes.name: fpe.c
nodes.summary: Implements portable helpers for enabling, disabling, suspending, and restoring floating-point exception trapping across Apple and GNU environments.

nodes.name: fpe.h
nodes.summary: Declares the driver-facing floating-point exception control API with C++ linkage compatibility.

layers.name: Core C API and Runtime
layers.description: Engine-neutral C interfaces, shared geochemical containers, lifecycle helpers, constants, diagnostics, and process-wide error handling form the foundation used by every adapter and driver.

layers.name: Reaction Engine Adapters
layers.description: PFLOTRAN, CrunchFlow, and ONNX implementations translate the generic Alquimia contract into engine setup, reaction stepping, state conversion, metadata, and inference operations.

layers.name: Fortran Bindings
layers.description: ISO_C_BINDING container mirrors, string conversion utilities, and an object-oriented Fortran facade expose the core C contract safely to Fortran callers.

layers.name: Mixed-Language Examples
layers.description: Focused C++ and Fortran experiments demonstrate string exchange, derived-type layout compatibility, and pointer-backed structure-array ownership across the language boundary.

layers.name: Driver Applications
layers.description: Standalone batch-chemistry and reactive-transport programs coordinate input parsing, engine execution, numerical transport, output serialization, and runtime diagnostics.

layers.name: Build and Project Support
layers.description: CMake and Make rules select engine integrations, build and install libraries and drivers, compile interoperability experiments, and preserve third-party licensing terms.
